description_en: Queries the details of consumer groups in a change tracking instance
description_zh: 查询数据订阅实例中的消费组详情
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-consumer-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --subscription-instance-id dtso5xx5t9u19e0000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值： 30、50、100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSubscriptionInstances接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ConsumerGroupID.description_en: The ID of the consumer group

ConsumerGroupName.description_en: The name of the consumer group

ConsumerGroupUserName.description_en: The account of the consumer group

ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_en: The consumption checkpoint, which is the point in time when the client consumed the last message in the change tracking channel. The time is displayed in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
ConsumptionCheckpoint.description_zh: 消费位点，即客户端在订阅通道内消费最后一条信息的时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

MessageDelay.description_en:
The message delay time, which is calculated by using the following formula: Message delay time = Current time - Timestamp of the earliest unconsumed message in the change tracking channel. Unit: seconds.
If this parameter returns -1, no client is connected to the consumer group
MessageDelay.description_zh:
消息延迟时间=当前时间-数据订阅通道中存在时间最早的未被消费的消息的时间戳，单位为秒。
如果该参数返回-1，则表示当前没有客户端连接该消费组

UnconsumedData.description_en:
The total number of unconsumed messages, which is calculated by using the following formula: Total number of unconsumed messages = Number of unconsumed change tracking data records + Number of heartbeat messages.
If this parameter returns -1, no client is connected to the consumer group
UnconsumedData.description_zh:
未消费的消息总数=未被消费的订阅数据数量+心跳消息数量
如果该参数返回-1，则表示当前没有客户端连接该消费组

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

PageRecordCount.description_en: The maximum number of consumer groups that can be displayed on one page
PageRecordCount.description_zh: 一页最多可展示的消费组数量

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of consumer groups
